rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the breadth, extent, or applicability of a subject.

example.english: The scope of this research is very broad.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jin4 gau3 ge3 faan6 wai4 hou2 gwong2

rows.note: Use this for the opportunities or freedom someone has to act, develop, or show their abilities.

example.english: This job gives you plenty of scope to show your abilities.
example.traditional: 呢份工俾你好多發揮空間。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 bei2 nei5 hou2 do1 faat3 fai1 hung1 gaan1

rows.note: Use this for the optical sight fitted to a gun or similar weapon.

example.english: The rifle has a scope, so it is much easier to aim accurately.
example.traditional: 支槍裝咗瞄準鏡，瞄得準好多。
example.jyutping: zi1 coeng1 zong1 zo2 miu4 zeon2 geng3 miu4 dak1 zeon2 hou2 do1
